about_snippet.label: About Me
about_snippet.heading: Who I Am
about_snippet.paragraph_1: I'm a Computer Science student at Universitas Negeri Malang and a Software Engineer at CV Solusi Cipta Media, where I'm building the Inventory Control module of an ERP for a two-plant manufacturer. Before that, I built the backend for Intervyou.me, an AI career platform used by 8,000+ people. I focus on backend development with FastAPI, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, and build full-stack features when a project needs them.
about_snippet.paragraph_2: I enjoy turning complex problems into clean, maintainable solutions, whether that's a scalable REST API, an AI-integrated service, or a polished front-end experience.

contact_cta.heading: Have a Project in Mind?
contact_cta.subtext: Whether it's a backend that needs to scale, an AI feature, or a full product from scratch, I'd love to hear about it.

bio.label: Introduction
bio.heading: About Me
bio.paragraph_1: I'm Ahmad Reza Adrian, a Computer Science student at Universitas Negeri Malang and a Software Engineer at CV Solusi Cipta Media, where I'm building the Inventory Control module of a manufacturing ERP. Before that, I built the backend infrastructure for Intervyou.me, an AI career platform used by 8,000+ people.
bio.paragraph_2: My core strength is backend engineering: designing RESTful APIs, modeling data with PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and integrating AI through the Google Gemini API. When a project calls for it, I also build front-end experiences with Next.js and React.
bio.paragraph_3: I believe clean, well-structured code and clear system design matter as much as shipping features. Right now I'm focused on deepening my system design and cloud-native skills.
